# TopWebTool — Public Index (llms.txt)

## Site Overview

TopWebTool is a 100% client-side web utility directory offering 85 free online tools across Finance, Marketing, AI, and Developer categories. All tools run entirely in the browser with no server-side processing and no data leaves your device.

## Public Assets

- [Homepage](https://topwebtool.com/) — Main tool directory with search and category grid
- [Global Script](https://topwebtool.com/global.js) — Shared JS for themes, header, footer, sidebar, and ad placements
- [Stylesheet](https://topwebtool.com/styles.css) — Global CSS with dark/light mode support

## Tool Directory

- [Acoustic Room Mode & Standing Wave Calculator](https://topwebtool.com/acoustic-room-analyzer/) — Compute axial, tangential, and oblique room modes from the resonance formula, flag problematic low frequencies, and check Bolt-area room ratios.
- [Age Calculator (Years, Months, Days)](https://topwebtool.com/age-calculator/) — Compute an exact age in years, months, and days between any two dates with total days, next birthday countdown, and the weekday you were born, leap-year safe.
- [Free Cron-Job & Automation Scheduler Builder](https://topwebtool.com/agent-cron-scheduler/) — Build a valid 5-field crontab expression from visual presets and custom fields, preview the next 5 run times, and copy it instantly. 100% Free, No Email.
- [AI Eval Matrix Engine - Compare AI Outputs](https://topwebtool.com/agent-eval-engine/) — Score AI outputs against a gold reference: Levenshtein distance, similarity percent, BLEU-1/2 precision, keyword overlap and character counts. 100% client-side.
- [Human-in-the-Loop HITL Planner for AI Agents](https://topwebtool.com/agent-hitl-planner/) — Design human-in-the-loop approval gates: pick agent steps, set approve/reject/edit types, timeouts and fallbacks, and export an interception plan with a flowchart.
- [LLM Context Window Token Budget Planner](https://topwebtool.com/agent-memory-matrix/) — Plan your LLM context-window budget: system prompt, conversation turns, memory/RAG content, and reserved output tokens. Utilization, remaining budget, warnings.
- [System Prompt & Tool-Calling Builder](https://topwebtool.com/agent-prompt-builder/) — Compose production-ready agent system prompts with persona, goal, context, constraints and output format, and emit function-calling JSON tool schemas.
- [Agent State-Machine Router Evaluator](https://topwebtool.com/agent-state-router/) — Model agent states and transitions, then auto-detect unreachable states, duplicate routes, infinite loops, and dead-ends. Exports DOT-style graphs. Free.
- [Multi-Agent System Topology Harness](https://topwebtool.com/ai-system-topology/) — Design multi-agent AI systems visually: add agent nodes with role, model and temperature, connect sequential, parallel and conditional edges, and export topology text plus Python skeletons.
- [Free AI Text Humanizer Helper | Redundancy & Robotic Pattern Detector](https://topwebtool.com/ai-text-humanizer-helper/) — Analyze copy text client-side to flag common repetitive patterns and robotic structures, helping edit towards natural voices. 100% Free, No Sign-Up Required.
- [CrewAI / AutoGen YAML Designer](https://topwebtool.com/autogen-yaml-designer/) — Design agents, goals, tools, and tasks in a visual builder and generate valid, properly indented CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom YAML config. Copy or download.
- [Free Secure Base64 Encoder & Decoder | Binary File & Text Translator](https://topwebtool.com/base64-encoder-decoder/) — Convert plain strings, text, or small binary files into standardized Base64 output streams offline. Secure, client-side. 100% Free, No Email Needed.
- [Battery Pack Busbar & Heat-Dissipation Modeler](https://topwebtool.com/battery-busbar-calculator/) — Size EV battery pack busbars: current per cell group, required copper or nickel cross-section from current density, voltage drop, and temperature rise.
- [Free Binary to Decimal Converter](https://topwebtool.com/binary-decimal-converter/) — Convert binary, octal, decimal, and hex numbers in real time with exact BigInt math. Live cross-base results with step-by-step details. Free, 100% client-side.
- [Biweekly Mortgage Calculator - Payoff Accelerator](https://topwebtool.com/biweekly-mortgage-calculator/) — Compare monthly vs biweekly mortgage payments. See how making 13 payments per year can shave years off your loan and save thousands in interest.
- [BMR & TDEE Calorie Calculator](https://topwebtool.com/bmr-tdee-calculator/) — Calculate Basal Metabolic Rate and Total Daily Energy Expenditure with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, plus cutting and bulking calorie targets. Free, offline, client-side.
- [Free Car Lease Estimator | Auto Lease Monthly Payment Calculator](https://topwebtool.com/car-lease-estimator/) — Calculate auto lease payments using MSRP, residual value, money factor, and trade-in. See complete depreciation & interest fee breakdowns instantly. 100% Free, No Sign-Up, No Email Required.
- [Cash Burn Runway Calculator - Startup Run Rate Planner](https://topwebtool.com/cash-burn-runway/) — Calculate how long your startup can operate before running out of cash. Track monthly burn rate, run rate, and runway with our free planner.
- [Free ChatGPT Prompt Optimizer | Persona, Formatting, & Context Injections](https://topwebtool.com/chatgpt-prompt-optimizer/) — Convert basic ideas into professional AI prompts. Auto-inject personas, constraints, variables, and markdown output configurations. 100% Free, No Email Needed.
- [CNC Feeds & Speeds Calculator: RPM & Chip Load](https://topwebtool.com/cnc-feeds-speeds/) — Calculate CNC spindle RPM, feed rate, and material removal rate from surface speed and embedded chip-load tables for aluminum, titanium, steel, and more.
- [Composite Laminate Calculator](https://topwebtool.com/composite-laminate-calculator/) — Calculate laminate thickness, areal weight, fiber volume fraction, and structural cost for carbon, glass, and kevlar composite layups.
- [Mil-Spec Connector Pinout Mapper](https://topwebtool.com/connector-pinout-mapper/) — Map Mil-Spec D38999 connector pinouts: pick shell size and insert arrangement, assign signal names to pins, and export a wire list as CSV.

- [Crypto Position Size & Risk Management](https://topwebtool.com/crypto-position-size/) — Crypto position sizing and risk calculator using the 1–2% account rule with entry, stop-loss, take-profit and leverage inputs. 100% free, client-side.

- [Depreciation Schedule Calculator - Straight-Line & DDB](https://topwebtool.com/depreciation-schedule/) — Generate business equipment depreciation schedules. Compare straight-line vs double-declining balance methods with full annual tables.

- [DSO Calculator - Days Sales Outstanding Tracker](https://topwebtool.com/dso-tracker/) — Calculate your business Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) to measure accounts receivable efficiency and improve cash flow management.

## Games & Play

- [Tic Tac Toe](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/tic-tac-toe/) — Classic 3x3 strategy game. Play against a friend or challenge the AI.
- [Snake Game](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/snake-game/) — Guide the snake to eat food, grow longer, and beat your high score.
- [Memory Card Game](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/memory-card/) — Flip cards and match pairs. Train your memory with emoji pairs.
- [Whack A Mole](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/whack-a-mole/) — Classic whack-a-mole arcade game with combo multipliers, difficulty ramp, and high score tracking.
- [Simon Says](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/simon-says/) — Repeat the color sequence to advance through increasingly challenging levels.
- [2048](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/2048/) — Slide tiles to merge numbers. Reach 2048 to win!
- [Sudoku](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/sudoku/) — Fill the 9x9 grid so each row, column, and 3x3 box contains 1-9.
- [Online Piano](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/online-piano/) — Play online piano with mouse or keyboard. 2 octaves, sustain, recording, and multiple waveforms.
- [Virtual Drum Kit](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/virtual-drum-kit/) — Play virtual drums with mouse, touch, or keyboard. 8 pads with synthesized sounds and loop recording.
- [Rock Paper Scissors](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/rock-paper-scissors/) — Classic hand game against computer. First to 5 wins the match.
- [Number Guessing Game](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/number-guessing/) — Guess the secret number between 1 and 100 with hints and streak tracking.
- [Speed Typing Test](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/speed-typing/) — Test typing speed and accuracy. Free WPM test with real-time results.
- [Hangman](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/hangman/) — Guess the hidden word letter by letter. Classic word puzzle with 6 wrong guesses.
- [Minesweeper](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/minesweeper/) — Classic Minesweeper puzzle. Clear the board without hitting a mine. Multiple difficulties.
- [Breakout](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/breakout/) — Classic brick breaker arcade game. Destroy all bricks with the ball and paddle.
- [Metronome](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/metronome/) — Precision online metronome with adjustable BPM, time signatures, and visual beat indicator.
- [Wordle](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/wordle/) — Guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries. Color hints show correct letters and positions.
- [Tetris](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/tetris/) — Classic block puzzle game. Rotate and stack falling blocks to clear lines.
- [Beat Pad](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/beat-pad/) — 16-pad MPC-style beat maker. Tap pads or use keys A-I and Q-I to trigger drums, percussion, and synth sounds.
- [Xylophone](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/xylophone/) — Play a 2-octave xylophone online. Use keys A-; and W E T Y U O P for realistic mallet percussion sounds.
- [Kalimba](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/kalimba/) — Virtual kalimba (thumb piano) with 8 tines. Pluck notes with keys A-H for relaxing African instrument sounds.
- [Trumpet](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/trumpet/) — Play trumpet online with 3 valves. Press 1/2/3 valves and Space to buzz notes from E4 to C6.
- [Ukulele](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/ukulele/) — Virtual ukulele with 4 strings. Pluck with keys A S D F, strum chords, and record your island vibe.
- [Online Flute](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/online-flute/) — Play flute online. Cover holes 1-6 and blow with Space to produce notes from D4 to C6.
- [Bell Set](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/bell-set/) — Play a set of 8 bells online. Ring bright bell tones with keys A-H or mouse click.
- [Bongos](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/bongos/) — Virtual bongos with high and low drums. Hit with keys A/S or mouse for Latin rhythm sounds.
- [Chord Progression Player](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/chord-progression-player/) — Hear common chord progressions. Play chords with keys 1-9, loop progressions at adjustable tempo.
- [Soundboard](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/soundboard/) — Trigger 9 sound effects with keys Q-C. Categories include SFX, animals, nature, and comedy sounds.
- [Beat Sequencer](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/beat-sequencer/) — 16-step drum sequencer with 4 instruments. Click to program beats, Space to play, presets included.
- [Theremin](https://topwebtool.com/games-and-play/theremin/) — Play a theremin by moving your mouse. X controls pitch, Y controls volume. Weird and wonderful.
